summary: Learn the effective safety training courses designed for workers. Boost your team's skills and confidence to maintain a safe and compliant workplace.
lede: Health and safety training covers how to design and evaluate learning that develops workers’ safety competencies. The course is for safety trainers, managers and coordinators who plan or oversee workforce education in operational settings. It develops skills in risk-based training needs analysis, instructional design, practical competency assessment, and measuring training effectiveness.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for experienced professionals responsible for the design and oversight of safety competency within complex operational environments.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least three years of experience in an occupational health and safety role or a training and development function. A basic understanding of ISO 45001 or similar safety management systems is required. No prior experience with instructional design software is necessary, but participants should bring a laptop for the training matrix and ROI calculation exercises.
